newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh overseas workers to get extra interest.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh overseas workers to get extra interest.

text.p: Bangladeshis working abroad and maintaining foreign currency accounts in the country will get interest as per the Eurocurrency deposit rates, a central bank circular said on Tuesday.

It said that while Bangladesh applied interest at prevailing Eurocurrency rates on accounts maintained as one-, three-, six- or 12-month term deposits, there was now such a provision for non-resident accounts being maintained without term deposit.

"Authorised dealers may apply interest at prevailing Eurocurrency deposit rates also on non-resident foreign currency accounts not especially maintained as term deposit, for balances not less than $1,000 and 500 sterling pounds or equivalent in other currency lying in the account for one month or longer," the circular said.
Bangladeshis working abroad send home about $1.0 billion annually.
Officials at the commercial banks said there was also a five-year "Wage Earners Bond" in taka, the local currency, at an annual rate of 11 percent for non-resident Banagladeshis.
